mission: Descent to the surface — passing through the ring structure. Ring 4 (seal boundary), Ring 3 (evacuation zone), Ring 2 (the city). Each ring escalates the wrongness. Veranthos didn't die — it drifted.
why_now: Physical approach to the wound — each ring escalation builds the sensory and emotional pressure
conflict: The city is overwhelming — buildings standing but wrong, vegetation growing without biological logic, the silence where birds should be. The wrongness cumulative, building chest pressure by the fifth street.
turning_point: The city. Homes, shops, a school. Evidence of life that simply... stopped. Not destroyed. Emptied and left to drift. The horror isn't violence — it's abandonment by the logic of the universe.
opening_hook: Ben steps through the seal boundary and the Force drops away — like walking from a faint breeze into stagnant air, except the breeze was the Force and now there's nothing
closing_hook: Ahead, in the valley between ridgelines: the Scar. A roughly three-meter vertical line in the air where the Force was torn and never fully healed. Not glowing. Not pulsing. A visual distortion like heat shimmer without heat. Ben stares at the seam in reality and feels the full weight of what Gavran did.
emotional_trajectory: Controlled descent -> escalating wrongness -> the devastating beauty of drift -> awe and horror at the Scar

stakes.personal: Ben experiencing the wound source — the thing his whole journey has been leading to
stakes.interpersonal: Each group member's reaction at different ring levels
stakes.external: Veraine is at the epicenter. Torin is moving toward it. The stage is being set.

setting: Veranthos surface — descending through rings: seal boundary, evacuation zone, city, approaching the valley
sensory_details: Ring 3: doors standing open, vehicles pointed away, a thousand years of overgrowth; Ring 2: the city — vines climbing then reversing, trees splitting buildings horizontally, flowers on shadow sides, no birds; Desh: grief-without-an-object settling in; the Scar: heat shimmer without heat, barely visible straight on, unmistakable from an angle
action_beats: Ben steps through the seal boundary and stumbles as the Force drops away entirely
The group moves through the city's empty streets — buildings standing but wrong, vines reversing direction, flowers in shadow
Ben stops at the valley ridge and stares at the Scar — a three-meter vertical distortion where reality was torn and never healed
notes: Use the full Veranthos world-building — ring structure, the city's oppressive wrongness, the Scar. Desh's non-Force experience: grief-without-an-object, chrono drift, wrong vegetation. This is the atmospheric payoff promised since Chapter 3.
